leadlag_C_tail_shape.interpretation: No interior peak anywhere in lags -25..+25. r rises monotonically for lag >= 0 and falls monotonically as |lag| grows on the negative side. Both are signatures of two smooth series, not of a delay, so no lead-lag delay is identified.

tail_decline_order_null.block_bootstrap_note: Invalid as a null: concatenating randomly ordered 25-row blocks mixes very different local levels and destroys the trend by construction (mean R2 = 0.024). Reported to document the failure, not as evidence.

finding4_fitted_columns.fit_definition_note: No analytic form is declared in the manifest. In the tail regime a centred moving average with a short window (w=3-7) reproduces the fitted column, but the fit is reproduced at least as well when the same smoother is applied to the raw channel after descending sort. The smoothing operator is therefore identifiable, while the axis the operator was applied along (row order vs. a magnitude-sorted sequence) is not resolved by these data.

dose_scan.quadratic_note: A quadratic in dose has 3 free parameters and the scan has 3 settings; the fit is exactly determined (R2=1 by construction) and carries no independent support for an interior optimum.

_meta.note: scipy was unavailable in this runtime; all statistics (OLS, correlations, permutation and bootstrap resampling) are implemented with numpy/pandas.
warnings: baseline a~b correlation becomes non-trivial (>|0.35|) under some segmentation variants; the null-coupling claim is boundary-sensitive.
